The person behind the project

The work is bigger than one person.

Mind Clarity grows from Uday Kumar’s enquiry into identity, self-understanding and the nature of experience, but the website is not centered on a personality.

The invitation is to explore the ideas, question them, keep your own discernment and discover what helps you respond to life with greater clarity, kindness and responsibility.

Personal support is available only as an optional final step, not as the purpose of the website.
